Xech Magmount Lamp is a smart, modern lighting solution designed for homes that value flexibility, aesthetics, and convenience. This innovative magnetic wall lamp combines dual installation modes, touch control, and cordless functionality to create the perfect bedside light, reading lamp, or ambient wall light. Whether you need a detachable night lamp for late evenings or a stylish glow for your living space, the Magmount adapts beautifully to your needs.

Built with a powerful magnetic mounting system, the lamp head effortlessly snaps onto the base and can be removed anytime for portable use. The rechargeable battery ensures a clean, wire-free setup, while the warm LED output creates a cozy atmosphere in bedrooms, closets, kitchens, and kids’ rooms. With its compact size and premium finish, it complements both contemporary and minimal interiors.

Key Features

  • Dual Mounting Options: Install permanently using screws or choose the adhesive sticker for a drill-free, damage-free wall setup. Perfect for renters and quick upgrades.
  • Powerful Magnetic Mount: Equipped with strong rare-earth neodymium magnets, the lamp head attaches securely while allowing easy detaching, repositioning, or angle adjustment.
  • Rechargeable & Cordless Convenience: Enjoy clutter-free lighting with a built-in battery. Recharge quickly with the included USB-C cable and use it anywhere without hunting for sockets.
  • Touch Sensor Control: Turn the light on or off and switch between Low, Medium, and High brightness levels with a simple tap.
  • Warm Ambient Lighting: Soft warm white LED glow makes it ideal for bedside walls, nightstands, wardrobes, hallways, and mood lighting.
  • Rotatable & Detachable Head: The 360° rotating design helps direct light exactly where you need it. Remove it from the mount to use as a portable lamp during power cuts or late-night movement.
  • Compact & Stylish Design: Minimal black & white finish with a sleek, space-saving profile (8×9×4.5 cm) blends seamlessly into modern décor.

The is more than just a wall light; it’s a multi-purpose lighting companion. Use it as a reading light near your bed, a magnetic night for children, a wardrobe light, or a soft accent for your hallway. The detachable feature makes it especially useful during emergencies or when you need focused light without disturbing others.

Unlike traditional wired fixtures, this rechargeable wall offers true freedom of placement. Install it inside cabinets, next to stairways, near study tables, or even in areas where wiring is difficult. The strong magnet keeps the stable, while the smooth rotation ensures precise illumination.

Designed for everyday usability, the touch sensor eliminates complicated switches. A gentle tap provides instant brightness adjustment, making it suitable for nighttime use when harsh light can strain the eyes. The warm LED tone promotes relaxation and enhances comfort, making your environment inviting and calm.

If you are searching for a cordless bedside, magnetic wall light, USB rechargeable lamp, or detachable night light, the delivers premium functionality wrapped in a compact, elegant form. What makes it special? Quick installation, zero visible wiring, portable convenience, and modern design – all in one intelligent lighting device.
